chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Ahmad ibn Abd al-Rahim Abu al-Sakhar, from Ismail ibn Abd al-Khaliq ibn Abd Rabbih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the prayer upon the deceased, you should say: 'O Allah, You created this soul and You caused it to die. You know its secret and its public matters. We have come to You interceding on its behalf, so accept our intercession. O Allah, appoint over it those it accepted as rulers, and gather it with those it loved.'

key_terms.وَلِّهَا: Appoint over it / Make it governed by

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to recite for the deceased during funeral prayers in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) outlines the specific supplication for the funeral prayer, highlighting the theological concept of *shafa'ah* (intercession) where the living seek Allah's favor on behalf of the deceased. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the continuity of spiritual bonds, asking that the deceased be united with those they loved and governed by their chosen leaders, thereby reinforcing the communal nature of death rituals in Islamic tradition.
